none: PAS CAM-6F47E0: Roman Coin : Copper-alloy Nummus of Helena, AD337-340
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ PAX PVBLICA ; D/ [FL IVL HE]LENAE AVG

A copper-alloy nummus of Helena, AD337-340 (Reece period 17). Reverse legend reads PAX PVBLICA. Reverse shows Pax left with branch and transverse sceptre. Mint is unclear. Obverse shows draped bust right. Obverse legend reads [FL IVL HE]LENAE AVG. Die axis is 6 o'clock, weight is 1.09g, diameter is 14.95mm
